about: Tool upgrades (docs/sandbox/TOOL-UPGRADES.md). Written by tools/constructs/upgrade_parts.py: fix it, not this file. Each stat: 'base' is where every survivor starts, 'creative' what creative gives, 'levels' each made by fitting its module 'part' (F on it, lying loose), in order of value; a higher Mk may be fitted over a lower. A function is base 0 and one level of 1. The stats' order is ToolStat's (Source/Constructs/ToolUpgrades.cs).

stats.name: Lift
stats.about: the heaviest thing the physics gun takes, in kg; its pull rises with it (30 N a kg)

stats.name: Reach
stats.about: how far the physics gun's beam reaches, in metres

stats.name: Drill bit
stats.about: the ground drill's scoop, times the digging table's radius

stats.name: Drill motor
stats.about: how fast the ground drill scoops, times the digging table's pace

stats.name: Fitting speed
stats.about: how fast timed fits, removals and welds go, times their usual pace

stats.name: Tractor beam
stats.about: the physics gun catches things out to twice its reach and reels them in

stats.name: Throw
stats.about: with the physics gun holding something, Reload throws it along the look
